subject: Controller / Processor alignment and SCCs — DPA redline + execution timeline
messages:
From: Cara Milton <cara.milton@novafarm.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: Procurement <procurement@novafarm.com>
Date: 2027-05-02 09:18:00 +0000
Subject: DPA redline + SCC mapping (Novafarm / Redwood)

Hi Lauren,

Attached are Novafarm's proposed DPA redlines and an SCC mapping we walked through in today's internal legal call. Key asks from our side:

- Confirm controller vs processor role language (we've flagged section 2.1 and related exhibits). Novafarm will remain controller for customer data; Redwood as processor for inference endpoints — please confirm this mapping in your DPA.
- Confirm whether Redwood can support a transfer addendum / TIA exhibit to document EU -> US fallback flow and compatible safeguards.
- Evidence request: SOC 2 scope page + list of subprocessor hosting regions for the last 12 months.
- KMS: We prefer customer-managed keys (bring-your-own) for sensitive datasets; please indicate support and any limitations.

We included inline comments in novafarm_dpa_redlines.pdf and a quick summary in redline_summary.xlsx. Procurement has asked for a target sign-off date of 2027-05-14 to stay on their onboarding timeline.

Can you confirm who on your side will own the redline walk and the evidence handoff? If useful, happy to schedule a 30-minute legal-to-legal call this week.

Thanks,

Cara Milton
Senior Counsel — Privacy & Data Protection
Novafarm Therapeutics
cara.milton@novafarm.com
+44 20 7123 4567

Attachment: novafarm_dpa_redlines.pdf (pdf, 1.2MB)
Attachment: redline_summary.xlsx (xlsx, 45KB)

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: Cara Milton <cara.milton@novafarm.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-02 12:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: DPA redline + SCC mapping (Novafarm / Redwood)

Hi Cara — thanks for sending and for the clear summary. Looping in Ben (Sales lead for Novafarm) and Olga (Data & Privacy counsel).

Quick answers up front:
- Role mapping: we'll confirm Redwood's standard language that treats us as processor when we process customer-provided data for inference. We've reviewed your flagged sections and will produce a clean comparison doc.
- Transfer addendum / TIA: we can provide a transfer addendum exhibit. Our EU fallback flows are documented and we will attach a TIA exhibit that aligns to SCCs (we typically provide a short narrative + exhibit table).
- Evidence: SOC 2 scope page and recent subprocessor hosting regions list — Olga, can you confirm if we can provide the SOC 2 scope PDF and an exported subprocessor CSV for the last 12 months?
- KMS / BYOK: Product supports a KMS integration for Dedicated and Private deployments. For Hosted API customers we currently offer service-managed keys; BYOK is supported on Redwood Private. We'll clarify the exact limitation (per-customer KMS vs tenancy model).

Proposed next steps:
1) Internal review + redline response: Redwood legal to return a tracked redline and a short reconciliation table by 2027-05-04 EOD. (Owner: Olga)
2) Evidence packet: SOC 2 scope + subprocessor list to Procurement by 2027-05-06. (Owner: Lauren / Olga)
3) Legal-to-legal call if needed — propose 2027-05-05 09:00 UK / 10:00 CET / 04:00 PT (30 minutes).
4) Target mutual sign-off: 2027-05-14.

If that timeline works, we'll start the redline pass immediately. Ben — can you confirm commercial constraints (any impact to order form or timeline)?

Best,

Lauren Bishop
Head of Contracts — Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

Attachment: acknowledgement.txt (note)

From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, Cara Milton <cara.milton@novafarm.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-04 08:27:00 +0000
Subject: Re: DPA redline + SCC mapping (Novafarm / Redwood)

Cara / Lauren,

Thanks — I've completed the redline pass and attached a reconciliation doc (sccs-mapping.docx) showing our proposed edits, plus a short table of the substantive differences. High-level notes:

1) Roles: We accept controller/processor mapping as proposed with a small clarification to 2.1 to explicitly call out "processing on behalf of" for the inference API and "controller" for customer-supplied PII used for model training (we do not train customer models on Hosted accounts unless a dedicated agreement is executed).

2) SCCs: We'll include the standard EU Commission module two clauses and our mapping in the TIA exhibit. We propose using SCCs Module Two (processor) + a short TIA narrative describing fallback routing and encryption-in-transit controls.

3) BYOK: For Private deployments we support customer-managed KMS (BYOK). For Hosted API we can offer a Bring-Your-Key pilot for customers under a Dedicated contract; the Hosted product currently uses service-managed keys. We'll document this limitation in the exhibit and offer a product roadmap note.

4) Evidence: SOC 2 scope (pdf) is included; subprocessor hosting regions are in the subprocessor CSV. Redline items that require commercial tradeoffs are flagged.

Action items I propose:
- Lauren to share evidence packet by 2027-05-06.
- Ben to confirm whether the order form needs a Dedicated SKUs addendum to enable BYOK pilot.
- Circulate one-pager for Procurement summarizing the differences and required exceptions.

I've attached: sccs-mapping.docx (redline reconciliation), soc2-scope.pdf (SOC 2 scope page), subprocessor-list.csv (hosting regions).

Olga Petrov
Senior Counsel, Data & Privacy
Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.ai

Attachments: sccs-mapping.docx, soc2-scope.pdf, subprocessor-list.csv

Cara / team — quick commercial note from Sales:

- The BYOK pilot is feasible but will require a Dedicated subscription path or Private deployment. That will change pricing and provisioning timelines (we estimate 3–4 weeks to provision Dedicated capacity for the pilot once contracts are signed).
- If Procurement needs the onboarding to stick to 2027-05-14, we recommend proceeding with the standard Hosted order form to hit the timeline and adding a BYOK addendum for a later rollout.
- I'll prepare a short amendment proposal for the order form that states the BYOK pilot as an optional add-on (pricing + provisioning window). Expect that doc by EOD 2027-05-05.
